To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the GHC’s personnel appears to be satisfied with the work content, the relation with co-worker, and the organization, while it appears to be less satisfied with the salary/other remuneration and the provided means/tools.

the employees at the GHC appear to have an overall satisfaction level of 0.72, which is quite high, and that the most important characteristics of the GHC, from their perspective, are the salary and other benefits and the means/tools provided, while the least important characteristics are the human resources management and the work content.

the GHC personnel are generally satisfied, particularly with the work content, the relation with co- workers and with the organization, while they are less satisfied with salary/ other benefits, the provided means/tools and the organization’s Human Resources management.

the assessment of employee satisfaction, a subject that is rarely addressed in health-care organizations.
the application of the MUSA methodology to the assessment of personnel satisfaction at a Greek hospital.
the satisfaction of personnel at the GHC, and the results of the study can be used as a basis for improving the personnel’s quality of life and the organization’s performance.

the employees’ satisfaction is relatively high, while there are some areas that should be improved.
the GHC is a good organization to work for, but it could improve its performance by focusing on the above-mentioned areas.

the MUSA method could be used as a tool for assessing the satisfaction levels of the personnel of health-care organizations, while at the meantime it could be used to evaluate the effectiveness of improvement actions.
the presented methodology is a useful tool to evaluate the overall and partial satisfaction level and to identify the strong and weak points of the employee satisfaction in health-care organizations.
